item.title: Veterans Day: remembering service, renewing responsibility
item.description: Like many in my generation, I grew up believing that military service was both an honor and a privilege. Military service was a family tradition. My great-grandfather was a Union soldier in the Civil War, my grandfather an artillery officer in World War I, and my father a B-24 Liberator pilot in World War II. My twin brother and I both served during the Vietnam War — he as a combat paratrooper, I as a C-141 cargo transport pilot.
